summary: Turn regulatory updates into impact assessments, control changes, and roadmaps. Explore this practical compliance operations course.
lede: Regulatory intelligence and compliance operations training helps compliance, risk, and policy professionals turn external changes into documented decisions and tracked actions. It covers classifying regulatory sources, screening applicability, assessing impacts, and linking obligations to risks and controls. Learners practise assigning owners, updating registers, planning change roadmaps, and building an Excel metrics dashboard for management reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who turn external regulatory change into compliance decisions, control updates, and accountable work across business functions.
prerequisites: Working exposure to compliance, regulatory affairs, risk management, policy governance, or internal audit is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Excel familiarity will help with the dashboard exercise.
